verdict.rationale: Stripe's Checkout docs say a single Checkout integration accepts one-time and subscription payments from more than 125 local payment methods, and Payment Links let customers pay with their preferred method. This supports the core idea of many methods from one integration. However, the pack never names Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects or BNPL, so the specific method types in the story are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet support, bank-redirect methods, BNPL methods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: Accept one-time and subscription payments from more than 125 local payment methods.
Let your customers use a link to pay in their local language and currency with their preferred payment method.
Customers enter their payment details in a fully-featured payment page, either embedded on your site or via a redirect to a Stripe-hosted page.
